absent: Internal layout of ww_mutex, ww_acquire_ctx, and ww_class beyond field uses visible here, including wound tracking and ownership linkage.
Behavior of ww_mutex_lock, ww_mutex_unlock, ww_mutex_lock_slow, ww_mutex_init, and ww_mutex_destroy outside these fragments.
Implementation of underlying rt_mutex trylock, fast path context install, and interruptible slow path helper.
Policy distinction between wound and die classes exercised by the suite runner.
Semantics of completions, workqueues, spinlocks, lists, random generators, timing checks, and sysfs objects beyond stub references.
Exact numeric error codes and logging output formats beyond paraphrased outcomes.
Memory ordering and lock dependency tracking rules for context publication across threads.

findings.text: Nonblocking acquisition service accepts a wound wait mutex together with an optional acquire context and reports success through an integer indicator with success distinguished from contention failure.
Interruptible acquisition service accepts a wound wait mutex together with an optional acquire context and forwards to an internal real time helper using an interruptible sleep state.

Single mutex trial control combines a schedulable work element plus a wound wait mutex plus three single shot peer coordination signals for readiness and start and completion plus a flag word that selects trial variants.

Opposite order trial control combines a schedulable work element plus a class reference plus two wound wait mutexes plus two single shot ordering signals plus selectors for resolution behavior and nonblocking mode plus integer outcome storage.

Ring trial control combines a schedulable work element plus a class reference plus an owned wound wait mutex plus a successor mutex pointer that closes a ring plus predecessor and successor coordination signals plus integer outcome storage.

Load trial control combines a schedulable work element plus a lock array reference plus a class reference plus a deadline instant plus a lock count. Reorder helper combines list membership plus one lock reference.

Context free nonblocking attempt bypasses wound tracking and maps to the underlying real time attempt. Contextual attempt discards any stale wound mark when the caller currently holds no acquisition, then upon underlying success installs the context through an accelerated path and records nested dependency information.

Shared random state updates are serialized by a dedicated spinlock that is held only for state advance plus bounded reduction, allowing concurrent trial threads to obtain disjoint shuffled orders safely.

Entire selftest collection is guarded by one blocking mutex held across full runs for both policies. An external trigger uses a nonblocking attempt on the same guard and skips execution while a run is already active.

Single mutex trial demands strict exclusion between main holder and peer worker. Peer completion observed while the main side still owns the mutex counts as failure and yields an invalid argument outcome after release and cleanup.

An owned wound wait mutex must reject self reacquisition. Nonblocking self attempts with or without context must fail, while blocking self attempt under the same context must return an already owned deadlock signal instead of granting recursive ownership.

Opposite order acquisition must expose a deadlock signal to at least one participant when resolution is disabled. When resolution is enabled both participants must finish successfully by releasing the first holding and reacquiring through a slow path in agreed order.

Single mutex peer moves from announced readiness into waiting for start permission, then into ownership acquisition where mode selects between repeated nonblocking attempts with voluntary rescheduling and one blocking wait, then announces completion while still owning, then releases ownership.

Each opposite order participant starts by taking its first mutex and confirming linkage to its own context, then exchanges ordering signals, then attempts the second mutex. Upon deadlock signal an enabled resolver releases the first holding, takes the second through a slow path, retakes the first, then releases both and finalizes the context with outcome saved.

Ring members each take an owned mutex, signal neighbors, then attempt a successor mutex with deadlock driven release plus slow path reordering until all rings resolve. Load workers repeatedly build a random permutation, acquire a set, pause briefly, release fully, and continue until a deadline passes, using inorder retention, list reordering, or single lock selection.

Startup seeds randomness, creates an unbound workqueue, publishes a kernel object with one writable trigger backed by an attribute list and group, then executes the full suite under guard for both policies. Shutdown releases the object and queue. The trigger reruns the suite unless a run is already active.

Exclusion checking depends on a short timed observation window with voluntary rescheduling. Scheduler delay or missed completion polling could hide a violation or falsely suggest one, and tight nonblocking retry without backoff can waste processor time while contended.

Resolver paths must pair every successful acquisition with eventual release and every context start with eventual finish. A missing release or finish after deadlock handling would leak ownership, corrupt later wound accounting, or stall workqueue draining.

Single mutex selectors use low order bit positions with spin observation in position zero and nonblocking acquisition in position one and contextual acquisition in position two, while position three defines the iteration bound for exhaustive mode coverage.

Load selectors use low order bit positions with inorder retention in position zero and list reordering in position one and single lock choice in position two, with a combined selector covering all three. Short observation spans one sixteenth of a timer second and each load phase deadline spans two timer seconds.

Portability aliases map a generic mutex name plus waiter name plus wait lock selector either to plain blocking primitives or to real time counterparts with nested lock selection. Two build markers select the real time wound wait compilation variant.

Immediately after initial acquisition each opposite order side expects the held mutex to point back to its own acquire context. Mismatch is treated as an internal consistency violation rather than ordinary contention.

Full suite order covers single mutex modes for all flag combinations, then self acquisition with blocking and nonblocking starts, then a four way matrix of opposite order blocking and resolution choices, then growing rings sized from two up through processor count plus one, then three load phases with widening lock counts and thread scaling. Class runner repeats this order for wound policy then die policy.

Random order producer returns a full permutation of trial indices using identity initialization followed by suffix exchanges against bounded random positions, with allocation failure propagated as a null outcome.
Contention widener inserts a short sleep of about one to two thousandths of a second while locks are held, increasing overlap between competing workers without changing lock ordering.

Load launcher distributes worker roles round robin across inorder and reorder and single lock kinds, skipping kinds not enabled by the caller selection, initializing each chosen worker with shared locks and a common deadline before queueing.
